intro.TrustedMarkup:
Editor support for the .syntax files std/grammar reads.

No program links this module, so it costs a program nothing. A tool finds it beside std/grammar by its name.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnCheckGrammar(root: String, path: String) -> Code

prose.TrustedMarkup: What the grammar at path refuses: the report syntax gives where it does not load or does not lower, at its line and column. root is the same path.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnDefinitionGrammar(root: String, path: String, line: Int64, col: Int64) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: The head of the rule a reference at 1-based line and col of the grammar at path names, as a path:line:col anchor, or "" where the name is no rule.

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnHoverGrammar(root: String, path: String, line: Int64, col: Int64) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: The line that defines the rule a reference at 1-based line and col of the grammar at path names, or "".

sig.TrustedMarkup: gen fn vyrnCompleteGrammar(root: String, path: String, line: Int64, col: Int64) -> String

prose.TrustedMarkup: Completion items at 1-based line and col of the grammar at path: the rules it defines, then the loader's built-ins. Returns a JSON array of {label, kind, detail, from}.
